caption: The drawing features three distinct objects illustrated in black ink on a cream or off-white background. At the top center, there is a short-sleeved garment resembling a blouse, decorated with detailed black embroidery along the neckline, sleeves, and a band below the chest. The embroidery forms intricate geometric and floral patterns. Below this, to the left, is a long dress or garment with short sleeves and a fitted bodice, shown in full length. This dress features similar embroidered decoration along the neckline and a wide band of complex embroidery around the hem, comprised of geometric and floral motifs. To the lower right, there is a vertical strip that appears to represent a section of fabric or a textile sample, with horizontal panels. Each panel displays various styles of embroidery, including repetitive bands of floral and geometric designs, with the lowest panel showing a dense, detailed pattern with a scalloped edge. The drawing is monochromatic, rendered entirely in shades of black and grey against the plain background.
title: Infant's Dress
